subject: Proof-of-Value: compact sprint calendar, success metrics & owners
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@brightbridge.ai>, Oliver Shaw <oliver.shaw@brightbridge.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proof-of-Value: compact sprint calendar, success metrics & owners

Hi Emma / Oliver —

Great conversation today — thanks for the time. Per our discovery call I pulled together a compact proof-of-value (PoV) plan aimed at a two-week technical validation + one-week readout. High level below; attached are a one-sheet success-metrics workbook and a calendar (.ics) you can drop into your schedulers.

Goal: demonstrate integration with BrightBridge ingestion + 1 API integration point and validate latency and relevance improvements on a representative query set.

Success criteria (proposed):
- Functional: Redwood API connected to BrightBridge dev cluster; end-to-end generation for 8 representative templates.
- Latency: median per-request latency <= 350ms at expected sample load (see test plan).
- Quality: precision@5 improvement >= 12% over baseline on the agreed evaluation set.
- Operational: automated prefix caching enabled; no errors > 5% during sustained 10m bursts.

Evaluation plan / ownership:
- Data handoff & ingestion validation — BrightBridge (Emma, Oliver) + Redwood infra support (Rishi).
- Integration + acceptance tests — Stephanie (technical champion at Redwood).
- Readout & business metrics — Camila (owner for success decision + slide deck).

Tentative timeline (compact sprint):
- Kickoff & environment access: Mon, 2027-04-19 (30–45m)
- Week 1: integration, baseline runs, config tuning (daily async updates)
- Week 2: evaluation runs, latency/load testing, quality checks
- Final readout: Wed, 2027-05-05 (30m) — results + next-step recommendation

Weekly cadence: brief standup on Fridays (15m) + asynchronous Slack updates in #bb-pov.

Immediate asks:
1) Confirm kickoff date (proposed 2027-04-19) and primary attendees.
2) Share dev cluster access (or a temporary S3 export) by 2027-04-16.
3) Confirm any procurement constraints (PO), cc procurement@brightbridge.ai if needed.

Attachments: BB_PoV_success_metrics.xlsx (workbook), compact_pov_calendar.ics (calendar invite)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
